responsibility: Implements GNAT symbol-name decoding services used outside Ada code. It inverts the Ada external name encoding described by the front end, translating mangled linker/debug names back into Ada dotted names, operator names, task/body markers, overload suffixes, and optional human-readable qualifiers, and also extracts colon-separated type encodings from triple-underscore suffixes. This is the executable logic behind the small adadecode.h API.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation member of the adadecode pair: it contains the actual decoding algorithms for __gnat_decode and get_encoding, including stripping triple-underscore type encodings, converting double underscores to dotted Ada names, recognizing operator-name encodings, and adding verbose qualifiers. Unlike gcc/ada/adadecode.h, it does the transformation work rather than merely declaring the API.
